newsitem.title: USA: Beverly Enterprises names Scott Tabakin CFO.
newsitem.headline: Beverly Enterprises names Scott Tabakin CFO.

text.p: Beverly Enterprises Inc, provider of post-acute healthcare services, said on Wednesday that Scott Tabakin had been elected executive vice president and chief financial officer.
The CFO position had been open since May 1995.
Tabakin will be responsible for the company's finance, accounting, risk management, tax and audit activities, a statement from Beverly said.
Tabakin had served as acting chief financial officer since September 1995.

Beverly operates 635 skilled nursing centers, as well as transitional acute care hospitals, institutional and mail-service pharmacies, assisted living facilities, outpatient therapy clinics and hospice and home health centers.
